brief: The canvas presents a deep-sea bathymetric map carved into dark, reflective obsidian. Sharp, 3D topographical ridges rise from the floor, partially obscured by thick, translucent layers of amber beeswax. Fine, luminous sediments drift and settle into the carved crevices, simulating a slow, continuous accumulation of geological strata. The scene undulates and shifts as light plays across the glassy textures and viscous wax, creating a sense of deep, historical time passing.

Thick translucent layers of amber beeswax partially obscure the terrain, while fine luminous sediments drift and settle into the carved crevices. The composition simulates geological time through slow, continuous movement of particles and undulating wax layers, evoking a sense of ancient, deep-sea processes unfolding beneath the ocean floor.
